name: Modal Overlay Recovery
description: Clear blocking overlays: run dismiss_overlays first, then click the close control of anything it reports as CSS-hidden or surviving, re-grounding after each dismissal.
notes: dismiss_overlays clicks real close buttons where it finds them and reports which overlays were only CSS-hidden — handle those by clicking their close control directly.
Re-read after each dismissal to verify it is gone and to refresh element IDs.
Call done after ALL blocking overlays are confirmed gone.
If read_page or inspect_hidden shows no cookie, newsletter, popup, banner, modal, close, dismiss, or accept controls remain, stop searching and call done.
